name: cavemio-button
title: Button
description: The base action: variants, 24–40px sizes, a 3% press, and status (pending, success, error) shown through an icon slot and a morphing label.

cavemio.accessibility:
- No external animation libraries: uses CSS transitions and native layout geometry.
- Anchor triggers for Popovers and Dropdowns are guarded from press scaling to preserve positioning geometry.
- Strict 1px thin line styling with zero drop shadows.
cavemio.previewNote: Interactive local fixture. Data and async results are simulated in the preview; the caller supplies application services.

props.name: loading
props.description: false · Shows an in-place spinner while retaining keyboard focus.

useCases.title: Form submits
useCases.description: Primary actions with in-place loading state that retains keyboard focus.

useCases.title: Toolbars & headers
useCases.description: Secondary and ghost buttons with thin line borders and adaptive press feel.

useCases.title: Destructive dialogs
useCases.description: Clean destructive actions with clear visual distinction and no blurry glow.

useCases.title: Icon triggers
useCases.description: Concentric square icon buttons with deeper tactile push feedback.

features.title: Adaptive press scale
features.description: Small icon buttons push deeper (0.95), wide buttons push subtly (0.985), and floating anchor triggers never scale so popover bounds remain pixel-perfect.

features.title: Smooth width morphing
features.description: When children or labels change, the button measures the new natural width and glides smoothly without jumping surrounding layout.

features.title: In-place loading state
features.description: Loading morphs a centered spinner into place while keeping the button focusable (aria-disabled) so keyboard users never lose their place.

features.title: thin line 1px precision
features.description: Pure 1px border tokens with zero fuzzy drop shadows and full dark mode compatibility.

states.title: idle
states.description: Resting button: filled primary, or a 1px thin line for secondary and outline.

states.title: pressed
states.description: Gives 3% and settles back in 200ms (none with reduced motion).

states.title: pending
states.description: The icon slot opens and a spinner blurs in; the label morphs; aria-busy, clicks swallowed, focus kept.

states.title: success / error
states.description: A check draws itself, or an alert with a short shake; icon-only buttons swap their icon the same way.
